name: @dsh-chamber/dsh-client-ui-layout
description: Minimal chamber-owned fork of the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout shell plugin (design 06): replaces ONLY the layout STORE so the sidebar width preference is shared across every N-ctx shell boot and persisted across restarts. The frame itself (AppFrame, service, theme presenter, columns) is imported from the vendor source via deep subpaths — the fork never re-implements the shell.
